summary: After the player declines an invitation, someone can approach them later about a different opportunity.
realLife: Malvina Harlan recalled that her husband John declined a diplomatic post because he wanted to stay in the United States. President Hayes later nominated him to the Supreme Court.
inGame: needs: the particular refusal read by the cause of a later, different invitation.

turns.what: The organizer asks the same person again after their evening shift ends.
turns.pulledBy: The first refusal was about work hours and the new invitation falls on a day off.
turns.writesBack: The later invitation keeps its own answer and date.

turns.what: The resident who declined to travel for the party agrees to cover the sign-in table at the local meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The organizer remembers the travel constraint and has a vacant shift within walking distance.
turns.writesBack: The roster lists one local shift and leaves the earlier traveling assignment declined.
